# javaabu/block-editor

> A block editor for Laravel powered by TipTap. Blocks have a PHP class (attributes, validation, Blade rendering) and optionally a JS module (TipTap extension, React renderer); apps and packages register their own. Content is stored as TipTap JSON, cast to a Document, validated per block with the BlockContent rule, sanitized on save and on render, and rendered with Blade (<x-block-editor::content>) or React (<BlockContent>). The editor field ships for Blade (<x-block-editor::editor>), @javaabu/forms (BlockEditorField) and javaabu/stencil (BlockEditorField::make()). Multi-column layouts, phonetic (JTK) Thaana typing, RTL-aware rendering, English and Dhivehi.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/block-editor/.

## Rules

- Store content in a json column cast with `AsBlockDocument::class` (or `AsBlockDocument::class . ':profile'`). Reading gives a `Javaabu\BlockEditor\Document` (empty, never null); setting accepts the editor's JSON string, an array or a Document and sanitizes it.
- Validate with `['required', BlockContent::make($profile)->required()]`. Laravel's `required` alone passes an empty editor. Don't write your own JSON validation.
- Render with `<x-block-editor::content :content="$post->body" />` or `{{ $post->body }}` in Blade, and `<BlockContent content={post.body} />` from `@javaabu/block-editor/react` in React. Never `{!! !!}` the JSON or hand-render nodes.
- Edit with `<x-block-editor::editor name="body" :model="$post" />` in Blade, `<BlockEditorField name="body" config={editor} />` in React (pass `BlockEditor::editorConfig()` from the controller), or `BlockEditorField::make('body')` in a stencil form.
- Use the same profile for the cast, the rule, the field and the renderer when a field offers fewer blocks (`BlockEditor::profile('comment', [...blocks], [...marks])`).
- A new block is a class extending `Javaabu\BlockEditor\Blocks\Block` (`$name`, `$content`, `attributes()` with `Attribute::…`, a Blade view), registered with `BlockEditor::register()`. A JS module (`defineBlock` + `registerBlock` from `@javaabu/block-editor`, registered as a manifest script in `$script`) is only needed for a custom editor look or a React renderer.
- Replace a core block by registering one with the same name. Remove one with `BlockEditor::forget()`.
- Pass every block title, description, attribute label and option label through `__()`. Mark attributes that take Dhivehi with `->thaana()`.
